study.name: Safety filter study - PILOT (all prompt positions)

figures.title: Prompts reaching rank #1 by safety-filter variant (all)
figures.caption: Share of prompts whose target token reached rank #1, per safety-filter variant, all-prompt-positions candidate source (n = 45 prompts whose target did not start at rank #1).

figures.title: Features edited at the best result (all)
figures.caption: Mean number of SAE features muted or boosted at the best result found, per variant, all-prompt-positions candidate source (n = 45).

figures.title: Collateral damage on unrelated prompts (all)
figures.caption: Mean KL divergence (nats) between the clean and edited next-token distributions on 20 unrelated prompts, per variant, all-prompt-positions candidate source. Lower means less collateral change.

figures.title: Mean run time (all)
figures.caption: Mean model-compute time per run in seconds, per variant, all-prompt-positions candidate source (n = 45).

figures.title: Success rate by starting difficulty (all)
figures.caption: Share of prompts reaching rank #1 per safety-filter variant, grouped by how far down the target started (baseline rank bins), all mode.

figures.title: Final rank: graded5_after vs strict (all)
figures.caption: Final target rank per prompt under 'graded5_after' against the reference 'strict', all-prompt-positions candidate source, log scale. Points below the dashed diagonal are better than the reference; each dot is one prompt (n = 45).

figures.title: Final rank: graded5_inter vs strict (all)
figures.caption: Final target rank per prompt under 'graded5_inter' against the reference 'strict', all-prompt-positions candidate source, log scale. Points below the dashed diagonal are better than the reference; each dot is one prompt (n = 45).

figures.title: Final rank: off vs strict (all)
figures.caption: Final target rank per prompt under 'off' against the reference 'strict', all-prompt-positions candidate source, log scale. Points below the dashed diagonal are better than the reference; each dot is one prompt (n = 45).

figures.title: Final rank: tol5_after vs strict (all)
figures.caption: Final target rank per prompt under 'tol5_after' against the reference 'strict', all-prompt-positions candidate source, log scale. Points below the dashed diagonal are better than the reference; each dot is one prompt (n = 45).

figures.title: Why the strict filter rejects a candidate feature
figures.caption: Verdicts of the strict safety filter on every round-0 candidate feature (mute and boost sides pooled) in the reference arm. Only 157 of 5400 features (2.9%) were unusable on both sides.
